fields.scope_id: u32 route or connected-fixture identity; no ordering inferred across distinct scopes
fields.local_order: u32 monotonic event order within the scope; tool bookkeeping
fields.source_order: u32 native instruction ordinal in an original trace; in a C reconstruction, per-operation order only. Provenance flag distinguishes these meanings.
fields.source_rva: u32 HERCULES.EXE RVA; zero for synthetic/external services
fields.raw_token: u32 target address token or raw service handle; never a host pointer
fields.argument: four u32 values copied by value from the observed packet/call/service boundary
fields.origin: u8 original instruction, controlled endpoint, static order, bookkeeping or unresolved
fields.domain: u8 order table, geometry, screen space, texture, palette/LUT, CPU surface, desktop DC, display or external
fields.semantic_owner: u8 unclassified unless source association is independently established
fields.flags: u8 fixture- or source-specific flags; zero means none

semantic_limits: Packet/raster primitive kind alone never assigns world, UI, overlay or other owner semantics.
Texture memory, shared palette/LUT, CPU-visible framebuffer, DC/window and display output are separate domains.
Present request and final output endpoint are distinct events.
Per-scope local order does not establish serialization between independent callbacks, OS routes or mode transitions.
A C reconstruction event is not an original instruction observation even when it carries a source RVA anchor.
